cycle: Match the current end of each curve to its opposite end, for a seamless cycle. If one end key is selected in the Graph Editor, that end is matched to the opposite one; otherwise matches the last key to the first. Matches tangent orientation, or tangent and value in Tangents and Value mode.
cycle_first: Match each selected curve's first key to its last key.
cycle_last: Match each selected curve's last key to its first key.
bouncy: Fit exaggerated tangent angles that add controlled overshoot around the targeted keys.
auto: Set automatic tangents on the targeted keys.
spline: Set smooth spline tangents on the targeted keys.
clamped: Set clamped tangents to smooth motion while limiting overshoot near equal values.
linear: Set straight linear interpolation through the targeted keys.
flat: Set horizontal flat tangents on the targeted keys.
step: Hold each key value until the following key.
plateau: Set plateau tangents to smooth extrema while reducing overshoot.
in: Apply {tangent} only to the incoming handle of the current key selection.
out: Apply {tangent} only to the outgoing handle of the current key selection.
first: Apply {tangent} only to the earliest targeted key.
last: Apply {tangent} only to the latest targeted key.
all: Apply {tangent} to every key on the targeted animation curves.
default: Use {tangent} for newly created Maya keys.
